thread:
marie_finance: Quick note: finance is greenlighting a limited pricing experiment next week. We'll run two price-sheets: 'beta_discount' (5-10% off select tiers) and 'control' (current pricing). Migration window 60 days, grandfathering option for accounts with active contracts. Spreadsheet: https://redwood.ex/sheets/pricing-experiment-1771009876
raj_finops: Thanks. We need clear rules for who is eligible. Proposal: exclude any account with dedicated or private deployments, exclude accounts flagged as enterprise, and skip partners. Rest get randomized 15% -> beta_discount.
emma_ops: From ops side: need to know how to handle billing cycle mid-change. Suggest pro-rate to the day and create a non-invoice credit line with reason_code=pricing_experiment to keep accounting clean.
lucas_engineering: Implementation note: we'll use stable assignment by hashing customer_id. Pseudocode: if (crc32(customer_id) % 100 < 15) -> beta. Also will emit event `pricing_experiment.assignment` with {customer_id, cohort}.
priya_sales: Sales requests opt-out workflow: AMs can request permanent grandfathering for strategic accounts. Who reviews?
raj_finops: Finance reviews all grandfathering requests; if MRR impact > $3k/month require VP finance sign-off. RevOps will maintain the final list.
emma_ops: CSV export ask: include columns account_id, cohort, original_monthly_rate, new_monthly_rate, prorated_credit, credit_reason, invoice_id. We'll schedule nightly export to /exports/pricing-exp-1771009876.csv.
billing-bot: Export queued: /exports/pricing-exp-1771009876.csv available at 1771014000.
marie_finance: For credits: auto-apply credits <= $75, manual review for credits > $75 and <= $500, block auto for > $500. All credits should include memo 'pricing-experiment-adjustment'.
lucas_engineering: We'll add feature flags: pricing-experiment.enabled and pricing-experiment.force-cohort=NONE|BETA|CONTROL. Also add emergency circuit-breaker metric `billing.pricing_experiment.errors` to alert.
priya_sales: Communication: can someone draft a one-pager for AMs with opt-out link and timeline? I'll put together a slide and share by EOD.
raj_finops: Timeline: config freeze Fri, QA week-of, soft launch to 15% Mon 09:00 PST, monitor billing diffs for 7 days, then expand to 30% if no issues.
emma_ops: Edge-case note: invoices already generated before cohort assignment day should not be retroactively changed unless the credit threshold is met. We'll append an audit note to the invoice if a manual credit was issued.
marie_finance: Great. I'll update the sheet with decision gates and approval matrix. Ping me if you need changes. :white_check_mark:
